server-family-reminders.title: Server family reminders
server-family-reminders.description: Keeps reminding you of shared family

intro.title: ⚠️ Protect yourself from scams
intro.description:
Only contact NymVPN support through the official channels listed below. We will never ask for your passphrase or contact you first via direct messages.

Received unexpected contact? It's likely a scam.

help.title: Help with translation
help.description: Make the app better in your language.

dns.title: Customize DNS
dns.top-description: By default, using Nym's recommended DNS servers. Configure custom servers below if needed.

details.title: Use custom DNS servers
details.description: Configure your own DNS for ad-blocking, content filtering, or preferred providers. Drag to reorder priority. ⚠️  May limit Nym connectivity.

delete.title: Delete NymVPN logs?
delete.description: Deleting logs improves privacy but prevents Support from diagnosing your connection issues.

export.title: Export NymVPN logs?
export.description: Shared log files can be viewed by recipients and anyone they share them with.

mixnet-tuning.title: Mixnet tuning
mixnet-tuning.desc: Customize traffic patterns of Mixnet mode

performance.title: Expected performance of current settings:
performance.footer: Expected round-trip latency (RTT) on a standard network

continuous-traffic.title: Send continuous traffic
continuous-traffic.description: Cover traffic is always sent to keep the pattern uniform. Adjust the sending rate of your packets.
continuous-traffic.warning: ⚠️ Your packets will be sent as they become available. This could reveal traffic patterns.

background-cover.title: Background cover traffic rate
background-cover.description: Choose how much cover you need.

mixing-delay.title: Packet mixing
mixing-delay.description: Adjust timing delays to change how well your packets are mixed.
mixing-delay.warning: ⚠️ Timing protection is currently turned off. This could put your privacy at risk.

anti-censorship.title: Anti-censorship
anti-censorship.intro: Enable these features if you're experiencing connection issues or NymVPN is blocked in your location.

quic.label: Enhanced connection (QUIC)
quic.content: Improves connections on restricted networks by wrapping WireGuard in QUIC (HTTP/3).

stealth-api.label: Stealth API connect
stealth-api.content: Protects against VPN blocking by using cover domains. Toggle on to use always, or off to use when normal connections fail.
stealth-api.error: Failed to enable Stealth API connect

amneziawg.label: Minimal obfuscation (AmneziaWG)
amneziawg.content: Disguises WireGuard traffic with decoy packets to prevent VPN blocking.

anti-censorship.snackbar-switch-on: Enhanced connection (QUIC protocol) will activate when you reconnect.
anti-censorship.snackbar-switch-off: Enhanced connection (QUIC protocol) will deactivate when you reconnect.

killswitch.title: Killswitch
killswitch.desc: Always on to protect your data

app-proxy.title: App & wallet proxy (beta)

socks5.info: ℹ️ Add this to your browser's proxy settings to route traffic through the Nym mixnet

http-rpc.info: ℹ️ Use this in MetaMask or other Web3 wallets to make RPC calls through the Nym mixnet. Replace <your-provider-url> with your actual RPC endpoint.

app-proxy.intro: Route app & wallet traffic through the Nym mixnet for enhanced privacy. This feature creates a local SOCKS5 proxy for apps, and a HTTP RPC proxy for wallets.

error-monitoring.label: Error & crash reports
error-monitoring.sublabel: Changes will apply after app and daemon restart.
error-monitoring.desc: Send crash info to help us fix bugs faster. Reports go through Sentry's secure system and include technical debugging data only.

network-stats.label: Anonymous network stats
network-stats.sublabel: Changes will apply after daemon restart.
network-stats.desc:
Help us build a faster network by sharing anonymous performance data from your region. We use this to optimize speeds, reduce disconnections, and steer server coverage where it's needed most.

Only network performance data is shared - never your browsing activity or personal data.

account.account-id-description: Safe to share. Use this to <support>connect with Nym Support</support>.
account.title: Account
account.account-linked: Backup login method linked via Privy.
account.account-not-linked: <button>Add a social login</button> method to your account.

split-tunneling.title: Split tunneling (beta)
split-tunneling.description-windows: Choose apps to exclude from NymVPN tunnel.
split-tunneling.description-linux: ⚡ Launch any app from here to be excluded from the NymVPN funnel and connect directly to the internet!
split-tunneling.exclude-warning: ⚠️  Excluding an app will leave it unprotected.
split-tunneling.problematic-app: App isn't available for split tunneling

info-dialog.title: Using split tunneling
info-dialog.description-windows: Split tunneling allows you to choose which apps use NymVPN.
info-dialog.description-linux:
Split tunneling allows you to choose which apps use NymVPN.

Tapping the icon next to an app will launch it outside the tunnel — it connects directly to the internet, unprotected by NymVPN.

direct.label: Direct
direct.description: Excludes the selected apps from the VPN tunnel, allowing direct internet connection.

remove-confirm-dialog.title: Remove {{appName}}?
remove-confirm-dialog.description: This removes the app from your custom split tunneling list. It won't uninstall the app, and you can add it again later.

launch-confirm-dialog.title: Launching {{appName}}
launch-confirm-dialog.description:
The app will be launched outside of the VPN tunnel and will connect directly to the internet (unprotected by NymVPN).

Before proceeding, please make sure the app is not already running. If it is, close all instances first, then launch the app from here.

error.failed-to-add-app-to-split-tunneling: Failed to add app to split tunneling
error.failed-to-remove-app-from-split-tunnelin: Failed to remove app from split tunneling

geo-exclusion.title: Geo Exclusion
geo-exclusion.description: Routes traffic for selected regions outside the VPN tunnel, so domestic apps work at full speed. Everything else stays protected.
geo-exclusion.beta-note: Beta version: China and Russia only for now. More regions coming.
geo-exclusion.warning: Traffic to excluded regions bypasses the VPN.

select-region.title: Select region
select-region.beta-note: Beta version: only one region can be excluded at a time.

macos.intro: On Firefox or browsers that permit SOCKS5 configurations.
steps: SOCKS Host 127.0.0.1, Port {{port}}, select SOCKS v5.
Check Proxy DNS when using SOCKS v5 (prevents DNS leaks).

windows.intro: On Firefox or browsers that permit SOCKS5 configurations.
steps: SOCKS Host 127.0.0.1, Port {{port}}, select SOCKS v5.
Check Proxy DNS when using SOCKS v5 (prevents DNS leaks).

linux.intro: On Firefox or browsers that permit SOCKS5 configurations.
steps: SOCKS Host 127.0.0.1, Port {{port}}, select SOCKS v5.
Check Proxy DNS when using SOCKS v5 (prevents DNS leaks).

errors.failed-to-start: Geo Exclusion couldn't start. Reconnect and try again.
errors.failed-to-set-port: Couldn't update the SOCKS5 port. Please try again.
errors.failed-to-set-region: Couldn't update the excluded region. Please try again.
